scope: Shared source-mention literal alignment in Factory Next

previous_problem.description: Both immediate same-source neighbor spans literally contain the requested phrase; old code only rebounded if precisely one neighbor matched. This invalidated otherwise supported source mention despite model revisions.

implementation.behavior: When 1 or 2 literally matching immediately adjacent spans belong to the same original source, bind selected+matching neighbor(s), sorted by start. Never admit distant, cross-source or fuzzy matches.
